# VFXSource Asset List

## Overview

This document lists the VFX source assets that can be placed on each layer of a VFXRecipe (BaseLayer / DetailLayer / ExtraLayer), together with the common fields shared by all source items and the user parameters each source asset exposes.

## Empty Sprite (Burst)

- **Resource Name**: VFX_UGC_Base_EmptySprite
- **NiagaraSystem**: `/CommonContent/VFX/Layer/0_Base/EmptySprite/VFX_UGC_Base_EmptySprite.VFX_UGC_Base_EmptySprite`
- **SpawnType**: burst
- **Element**: Empty
- **Layer**: Base
- **Description**: A blank sprite template (burst-type) for manual authoring. Not used in AI composition.

### User Parameters

#### Position

- Type: Vector3
- Description: Local position relative to the VFXRecipe root

#### Rotation

- Type: Vector3
- Description: Local rotation relative to the VFXRecipe root

#### Delay

- Type: number
- Description: Delay before playback starts (seconds)

#### SpawnCount

- Type: number
- Description: Number of particles spawned at once on activation

#### Lifetime_Min

- Type: number
- Description: Minimum particle lifetime (seconds)

#### Lifetime_Max

- Type: number
- Description: Maximum particle lifetime (seconds)

#### BoundSize

- Type: Vector3
- Description: Size of the bounds within which particles spawn

#### Size2D

- Type: Vector2
- Description: Particle size (width/height)

#### Color

- Type: ColorSequence
- Description: Particle color

#### Transparency

- Type: number
- Description: Transparency (0–1)

#### Texture

- Type: Content
- Description: Source texture

#### Acceleration

- Type: Vector3
- Description: Particle acceleration

#### FlipbookMode

- Type: number
- Description: Flipbook animation playback mode

#### FlipbookRows

- Type: number
- Description: Number of flipbook animation rows

#### FlipbookColumns

- Type: number
- Description: Number of flipbook animation columns
